queries.result: First-party discovery found the Government of Bihar Bhu-Naksha cadastral viewer and Bihar Revenue and Land Reforms land-record portal. The viewer is an official NIC/Directorate of Land Records & Survey service.

queries.result: First-party discovery identified Mahesh Khunt in Khagaria district, Gogri subdivision/circle, and the official Hindi Bihar land-record and Bhu-Naksha services. The public viewer exposed a cadastral map hierarchy but not anonymous parcel geometry.

registryEvidence.custodian: Directorate of Land Records & Survey, Government of Bihar; Department of Revenue and Land Reforms, Government of Bihar
registryEvidence.basis: The official Bhu-Naksha viewer identified a live cadastral map for Khagaria district, Gogri subdivision, Gogri circle, Mahesh Khunt mauza. This is local cadastral map evidence, although no polygon geometry response was obtained.

officialSources.observation: Current JavaScript/configuration exposed REST endpoints for level discovery, map extent, plot-at-coordinate lookup, and WMS map rendering.
officialSources.scope: Bihar cadastral map service; the selected hierarchy was Khagaria (21) / Gogri subdivision (02) / Gogri circle (06) / Mahesh Khunt mauza (0182), cadastral survey, CS Map, sheet 00.

officialSources.observation: Official viewer landing page identifies Bhu-Naksha as NIC cadastral mapping software and the Directorate of Land Records & Survey, Government of Bihar.
Official Bihar Revenue and Land Reforms portal links Bhu-Naksha, land records, and survey services.

requests.outcome: Enumerated official hierarchy and confirmed Khagaria code 21, Gogri subdivision code 02, Gogri circle code 06, and Mahesh Khunt mauza code 0182.

A bounded lookup at the map extent midpoint returned safe native identity id k4ZkyGu4SUqdwwEbbsTFBQ and plot number 78, but attributes_json was null and no geometry was returned. This was not treated as a citywide absence test.

A bounded anonymous GetFeatureInfo attempt for PLOT_LIST did not return a usable response; no geometry was retained. The viewer's ordinary WMS map route was observed in current JavaScript but was not converted into parcel geometry.
The plot-detail route required authorization/session state from this environment; no login or credential flow was attempted.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official Bihar cadastral viewer with a confirmed Mahesh Khunt cadastral-map hierarchy.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Mahesh Khunt map extent and one safe native plot identity were verified anonymously; polygon geometry was not exposed by the bounded requests.

remainingUncertainty: The official viewer may expose geometry through an authenticated or session-bound detail route, or through a different map request, but no anonymous bounded ID-plus-polygon response was verified. The exact WUP point was preserved and not used to infer citywide absence.
